selected_evidence.summary: STP bridge-id fingerprints captured via tcpdump on each interface confirm node1 eth1<->node2 eth1 (transit), node1 eth2<->node3 eth1 (lan-a), node2 eth2<->node4 eth1 (lan-b)

selected_evidence.requirement: Transit and private network IP configuration applied and working
selected_evidence.summary: Static addressing on transit (10.10.0.0/30) and lan-a/lan-b applied via UCI/ip commands; node1<->node2 transit ping succeeds

selected_evidence.requirement: Encrypted WireGuard tunnel established between node1 and node2
selected_evidence.summary: wg show on both routers shows active peer, handshake completed, and traffic counters incrementing over the vpn interface

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 and node4 reach each other by private address, and that traffic is encrypted in transit
selected_evidence.summary: node3 pings node4's private IP (10.10.2.2) successfully while a concurrent tcpdump on node1's transit interface shows only encrypted UDP/51820 WireGuard packets, never plaintext ICMP

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistence of node3/node4 private network config across reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Static IP and route added to /etc/network/interfaces; validated via ifdown/ifup cycle that config reapplies correctly
